title: F8 2015 - Big Code: Developer Infrastructure at Facebook's Scale
summary: An F8 2015 talk touring the tool-chain Facebook uses to let thousands of engineers build mobile apps, including its move to Mercurial, an Atom-based IDE and continuous integration.
why: HN points to it as a look at developer infrastructure at large scale, with speakers covering source control and CI test selection.

quote.text: It's a long video but it's very watchable using the YouTube speed multiplier.
